name: Soulshots & Spiritshots
description: Core consumables that instantly empower the next physical attack (Soulshot: 100% P. Atk bonus) or magic spell (Spiritshot: 100% M. Atk & Cast Speed boost).
notes: In Essence, shot grades are unified into single universal Soulshots/Spiritshots (unlike Classic which had grade-specific D/C/B/A shots). [SOURCE CONFLICT — documented in source_conflicts.json].

name: Soul Crystals (Aden & Hardin)
description: Gemstones inserted into weapon and armor sockets (Slot 1 and Slot 2) to grant customizable scaling passive attributes and proc chances.

facts.insertion_currency: B-grade Gemstone for standard, A-grade Gemstone for Transcendent

stat_effects_at_lv1.stun_proc: 3% trigger chance for 3s Stun on attack (60s cd)
stat_effects_at_lv1.silence_proc: 3% trigger chance for 5s Silence on attack (60s cd)

notes: Core progression mechanic providing continuous stat scaling throughout mid and endgame.

name: Dolls System
description: Account-wide collectible totems representing Lineage II bosses and monsters that grant passive stats and active aura abilities.

notable_boss_dolls.name: Queen Ant Doll
notable_boss_dolls.bonus: P. Atk / P. Skill Power / Critical Damage boost

notable_boss_dolls.name: Orfen Doll
notable_boss_dolls.bonus: M. Atk / M. Skill Power / Magic Critical Damage boost

notable_boss_dolls.name: Baium Doll
notable_boss_dolls.bonus: All Skill Cooldown reduction / P. & M. Atk boost

notable_boss_dolls.name: Zaken Doll
notable_boss_dolls.bonus: Vampiric Rage (HP Drain) / Critical Rate boost

notable_boss_dolls.name: Antharas Doll
notable_boss_dolls.focus: Damage reflection / Max HP & CP / Stun resistance

compounding_cost.compounding_success_rate: 10% per attempt for 1 doll compound, scaling with guaranteed pity points

notes: Dolls apply account-wide passively from inventory without occupying equipment slots.

name: Growth Rune
description: Stackable inventory item upgrading from Level 1 to Level 25 via compounding that amplifies Acquired EXP, SP, and flat offensive stats.

facts.stacking_rule: Equipping multiple runes of the same level does not sum up the buff; highest active takes effect
facts.acquisition: L-Coin Store, Project Eva Shop (Lv 1 costs 4500 Eva Points + 1,000,000 Adena)
facts.enhancement: Compounding with another Growth Rune of the exact same level

name: Scroll of Blessing (Weapon & Armor)
description: Special scrolls imbuing equipment with Blessed status, granting Combat Power, bonus stats, and unique visual aura.

blessing_effects.weapon: Adds bonus P./M. Atk, increases Soulshot/Spiritshot efficiency
blessing_effects.armor: Adds bonus Max HP, Max MP, and damage reduction

notes: Can be applied safely without breaking the item on failure.
